resources.string:
• Swipe left on a saved plan to rename or delete it.
• Search from the overlay with the current destination filled in, or clear a search with one tap.
• Show matching Links in a temporary overlay without changing saved plan progress.
• Count the Keys needed for each plan and the Keys still needed for the current origin.
• Minimize to the nearer edge, and move or resize the overlay preview with the option to restore defaults.
• Read this changelog offline from About.
• Keep separate Link progress for multiple plans.\n• Find Portals by name and view their matching Links.\n• Added the icon dock, language settings, and About. Launch Ingress from Home.
• Added English translations alongside Simplified Chinese.
• Added a privacy policy link and disabled cloud backups for plans and progress.\n• Hardened Gradle Wrapper downloads and verification.
• Updated the launcher icon, added the Apache 2.0 license, and made unsigned release builds possible from source.
• Highlight the overlay when a Link starts at a different Portal than the preceding Link.\n• Automated signed GitHub releases.
• First public release: import a Maxfield plan, follow Links in a movable overlay, and resume saved progress.
